_about: Names and terms written more than one way across the sheet. scripts/quality_checks.py finds every cell that uses one of the forms and asks the researcher which to keep (page /quality-spelling/). Put the form most rows use first. A term with "fix" is a plain typo: the fix is proposed even when only one form is left. Add new pairs as drafting finds them; once settled they drop out on their own, because only one form is left.
_capitals: Names that keep their capitals wherever they appear, written the right way. A lower-case "Black sea" is changed to "Black Sea" (one rule on /quality-spelling/), and the title rule never lowers their words. Add a name here when the title rule would lower it, like the name of a group or a painting.
